tests.name: Bootstrap test SysOp
Register dedicated ISS NPC identity for isolated pursuit acceptance
Register ordinary pursuit target
Register target whose ship is removed
Read ISS, target and removed-target identities

data.sql: SELECT (SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE lower(name) IN ('iss','interpolar security station','federation security','federation administrator') ORDER BY CASE lower(name) WHEN 'iss' THEN 0 WHEN 'interpolar security station' THEN 1 WHEN 'federation security' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,player_id LIMIT 1),(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE lower(name) IN ('iss','interpolar security station','federation security','federation administrator') ORDER BY CASE lower(name) WHEN 'iss' THEN 0 WHEN 'interpolar security station' THEN 1 WHEN 'federation security' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,player_id LIMIT 1),(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='fed_iss_target_qa'),(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='fed_iss_removed_qa');

tests.name: Select a directly connected non-FedSpace sector for pursuit movement

data.sql: SELECT to_sector FROM sector_warps WHERE from_sector=300 AND to_sector>10 ORDER BY to_sector LIMIT 1;

tests.name: Detach ISS while moving its active ship atomically across sector context

data.sql: UPDATE players SET sector_id=300,ship_id=NULL WHERE player_id=@{iss_player_id};

tests.name: Move ISS hull to non-FedSpace pursuit sector
Restore ISS active ship at pursuit sector

data.sql: UPDATE players SET ship_id=@{iss_ship_id} WHERE player_id=@{iss_player_id};

tests.name: Detach ordinary target for sector move

data.sql: UPDATE players SET sector_id=300,ship_id=NULL WHERE name='fed_iss_target_qa';

tests.name: Move ordinary target hull to pursuit sector
Restore ordinary target active ship

data.sql: UPDATE players SET ship_id=@{target_ship_id} WHERE name='fed_iss_target_qa';

tests.name: Remove the second player's active ship before incident settlement

data.sql: UPDATE players SET ship_id=NULL WHERE name='fed_iss_removed_qa';

tests.name: Remove prior dedicated incident rows

data.sql: DELETE FROM npc_security_incidents WHERE idempotency_key LIKE 'qa:fed-iss-pursuit:%';

tests.name: Remove prior dedicated action rows

data.sql: DELETE FROM npc_action_log WHERE idempotency_key LIKE 'iss:response:%';

tests.name: Register ordinary target ship as protected asset

data.sql: INSERT INTO federation_protected_assets(asset_kind,asset_id,reason,enabled) VALUES('ship',@{target_ship_id},'FED-03 ISS pursuit QA',TRUE) ON CONFLICT(asset_kind,asset_id) DO UPDATE SET enabled=TRUE,reason=EXCLUDED.reason;

tests.name: Create eligible active ISS incident

data.sql: INSERT INTO npc_security_incidents(idempotency_key,offender_player_id,protected_asset_kind,protected_asset_id,origin_sector_id,status,expires_at) SELECT 'qa:fed-iss-pursuit:eligible',player_id,'ship',@{target_ship_id},300,'open',CURRENT_TIMESTAMP+INTERVAL '1 hour' FROM players WHERE name='fed_iss_target_qa';

tests.name: Create incident whose player has no active ship

data.sql: INSERT INTO npc_security_incidents(idempotency_key,offender_player_id,protected_asset_kind,protected_asset_id,origin_sector_id,status,expires_at) SELECT 'qa:fed-iss-pursuit:removed',player_id,'ship',@{removed_ship_id},300,'open',CURRENT_TIMESTAMP+INTERVAL '1 hour' FROM players WHERE name='fed_iss_removed_qa';

tests.name: Create active incident one warp beyond ISS

data.sql: INSERT INTO npc_security_incidents(idempotency_key,offender_player_id,protected_asset_kind,protected_asset_id,origin_sector_id,status,expires_at) SELECT 'qa:fed-iss-pursuit:moving',player_id,'ship',@{removed_ship_id},@{iss_neighbor_sector},'open',CURRENT_TIMESTAMP+INTERVAL '1 hour' FROM players WHERE name='fed_iss_removed_qa';

tests.name: Assert prepared non-FedSpace incidents, movement route and target state

data.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*)=3 FROM npc_security_incidents WHERE idempotency_key LIKE 'qa:fed-iss-pursuit:%')::int,(SELECT shields=100 AND sector_id=300 FROM ships WHERE ship_id=@{target_ship_id})::int,(SELECT ship_id IS NULL FROM players WHERE name='fed_iss_removed_qa')::int,(SELECT sector_id>10 FROM players WHERE player_id=@{iss_player_id})::int,(SELECT COUNT(*)=1 FROM sector_warps WHERE from_sector=300 AND to_sector=@{iss_neighbor_sector})::int;
